info.title: Crack GRE Vocab API
info.description: Local API contract for the Milestone 1 cold rebuild.

get.description: Return the stable, non-readiness service document.
Return the learner represented by the current server session.
Issue the masked token required by session-backed mutations.

post.description: Cancel the pending link without touching either identity.
Confirm the pending link and establish the learner session.
Send recovery instructions without revealing account existence.
Replace a password after validating one short-lived reset token.
Create a Django session from an email and password.
End the current session without exposing whether it existed.
Create and immediately sign in a new learner.

get.description: Build the snapshot using the learner's requested IANA timezone.
Check the database without exposing connection failure details.

post.description: Plan a bounded Study Session for the authenticated learner.
Persist a recall answer and return authoritative study progress.

get.description: Return the active Study Session or a not-found response.

ApiMessage.description: Describe an API response carrying one human-readable message.

AuthValidationError.description: Describe malformed JSON or field-level account input errors.

CsrfToken.description: Return a masked CSRF token for one unsafe request.

GoogleLinkConfirmRequest.description: Validate password proof for an explicitly pending Google link.

LearnerAccount.description: Return the public portion of the current learner account.

PasswordResetConfirmRequest.description: Validate the opaque identity, token, and replacement password shape.

Readiness.description: Describe the stable ready or database-unavailable response shape.

SignInRequest.description: Validate the credentials supplied for a new server session.

SignUpRequest.description: Validate and create a clean-rebuild learner account.

planned_new_word_count.description: Derive how many persisted items introduce new Words.

item_count.description: Derive total progress from the persisted session items.

answered_count.description: Return how many planned items have accepted answers.

remaining_count.description: Return how many planned items still need an accepted answer.
